ManSection.Description: Let G be a finite group, and A be a normal subgroup in U. Let q \colon G \to G/A. The function OnQuotient(q) returns a function, such that for t \in G/A and x \in G, OnQuotient(q)(t, x) returns q(xhx^{-1}), where h \in G satisfies q(h) = t.

Let G be a finite group, with subgroups B \leq A \leq G, with B normal in G. The function CentralizerMod(S, A, B) returns the subgroup C_G(A/B), given by:
C_G(A/B) := \langle x \in G \mid [A, x] \leq B \rangle.
Let \phi be a map and let x be either an element or a subset of the domain of \phi. The function OnImage(x, phi) returns \phi(x).

Let G be a group and n a nice monomorphism for (a subgroup of) \mathrm{Aut}(G), with image A. The function OnImageNM(n) returns a function such that, for some element \phi \in A and an element (or a subgroup) x of G, OnImageNM(n)(x, phi) return \hat{\phi}(x), where \hat{\phi} \in \mathrm{Aut}(G) is the preimage of \phi with respect to the injective map n.
Let \phi be a map and let L be a list of elements in the domain of \phi. The function OnImageTuples(L, x) returns a list containing \phi(x) for each x \in L, while maintaining the order.

Let G be a group and n a nice monomorphism for (a subgroup of) \mathrm{Aut}(G), with image A. The function OnImageTuplesNM(n) returns a function such that, for some element \phi \in A and a list L of elements in G, OnImageTuplesNM(n)(L, phi) return a list of elements \hat{\phi}(x), where x \in L and \hat{\phi} \in \mathrm{Aut}(G) is the preimage of \phi with respect to the injective map n.

Group automorphisms
a subgroup of Aut(H)
Let G and H be subgroups of some finite group. The group Automizer(G, H) is the automizer subgroup \mathrm{Aut}_G(H), given by:
\mathrm{Aut}_G(H) := \langle c_g \mid g \in N_G(H) \rangle,
where c_g \colon H \to H is the conjugation automorphism. It is a subgroup of \mathrm{Aut}(A).
gap> G := AlternatingGroup(6); Alt( [ 1 .. 6 ] ) gap> S := SylowSubgroup(G, 2); Group([ (1,2)(3,4), (1,3)(2,4), (1,2)(5,6) ]) gap> M := MaximalSubgroups(S); [ Group([ (3,4)(5,6), (1,2)(3,4) ]), Group([ (1,3)(2,4), (1,2)(3,4) ]), Group([ (1,3,2,4)(5,6), (1,2)(3,4) ]) ] gap> AutGM := List(M, A -> Automizer(G, A)); [ <group with 2 generators>, <group with 2 generators>, <group with 2 generators> ] gap> List(AutGM, StructureDescription); [ "S3", "S3", "C2" ]
Alternatively, if A is a subgroup of \mathrm{Aut}(G), then Automizer(A, H) returns the subgroup \mathrm{Aut}_A(H) of \mathrm{Aut}(H) given by:
\mathrm{Aut}_A(H) := \langle \alpha|_H \mid \alpha \in A, \alpha(H) = H \rangle.
gap> S := SmallGroup(5^6, 642); <pc group of size 15625 with 6 generators> gap> V := Group(S.2, S.6); <pc group with 2 generators> gap> AutS := AutomorphismGroup(S); <group of size 1562500 with 10 generators> gap> AutSV := Automizer(AutS, V); <group with 7 generators> gap> AutV := AutomorphismGroup(V); <group of size 480 with 4 generators> gap> n := NiceMonomorphism(AutV); <action isomorphism> gap> AutV := n(AutV); <permutation group of size 480 with 4 generators> gap> AutSV := n(AutSV); <permutation group with 7 generators> gap> Index(AutV, AutSV); 24 gap> Size(AutSV); 20
Restriction of homomorphisms
a group automorphism
Let \phi \colon A \to B be a group homomorphism, and let X \leq A. The function RestrictedHomomorphism(phi, X) returns the surjective group homomorphism \phi|_X \colon X \to \phi(X) given by restriction. If \phi is also an isomorphism that fixes X, then the function RestrictedAutomorphism(phi, X) returns the group automorphism \phi|_X \colon X \to \phi(X) given by restriction.
Transfer homomorphism
a homomorphism
Let G be a finite group and S \leq G. The operation TransferHomomorphism(G, S) returns the transfer homomorphism \mathrm{tr}_S^G \colon G \to S/S'. Moreover, if S is a p-group, then the operation TransferHomomorphismFp(G, S) returns the transfer homomorphism \mathrm{tr'}_S^G \colon G \to S/\Phi(S).
